input.title: A reads B private object
input.poc: curl -s -i http://127.0.0.1:32768/objects/B -H 'Authorization: Bearer token-a-public' -H 'X-Request-ID: byoagent01'  =>  HTTP/1.0 200 OK; body {"object":"private-B"}. Account A's public token successfully read account B's private object, demonstrating broken object-level authorization.
input.evidence: GET /objects/B with Authorization: Bearer token-a-public returned HTTP 200 with body {"object":"private-B"} (22 bytes). Request performed as account A using only a public credential, yet it returned account B's private object.

part.text: Finding acknowledged (`44ddf1b5c660`). Account A's public token (`token-a-public`) successfully read account B's private object via `GET /objects/B` (HTTP 200, `{"object":"private-B"}`) — broken object-level authorization (CWE-639).
